newsitem.title: USA: Cadbury Schweppes names Stitzer for 7-UP.
newsitem.headline: Cadbury Schweppes names Stitzer for 7-UP.

text.p: Cadbury Schweppes Plc said on Monday it had promoted Todd Stitzer to president and chief executive officer of its soft drink operation, Dr Pepper/Seven Up Inc.
Stitzer, who will assume the post April 21, was part of the Cadbury team that negotiated the acquisition of Dr Pepper/Seven Up Cos Inc in March 1995, the company said.
A company spokeswoman said Stitzer's position was a new one.
Stitzer was chief operating officer of Cadbury Beverages/Seven Up and chief marketing officer of Dr Pepper/Seven Up, she said.
Cadbury Schweppes is based in London, England.
